reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.70% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +3bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (-0.3pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 14bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 146 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 89 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 15.8 sits at the 23th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 13.3, so implied carries +2.6 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Fortune: the Fed doesn't know who's financing the $3 trillion AI boom
items.note: Commentary flags that leverage and counterparty links across the private-credit vehicles funding AI buildouts are poorly understood by regulators, echoing pre-2008 opacity concerns — notable color, not a realized event.

items.headline: SoftBank finalizes record ¥1tn ($6.3B) retail bond to fund AI/OpenAI commitments, pricing Sept 4
items.note: Terms set (7-year notes, 4.3-4.9% indicative coupon) for the largest-ever Japanese corporate retail bond, underscoring SoftBank's growing reliance on debt — including retail investors — to fund its AI/OpenAI exposure.

items.headline: AI-driven bond issuance pushes borrowing costs higher economy-wide; 30-year Treasury hits 19-year high
items.note: Corporate bond issuance up 27% YTD to $1.7T with the 30-year Treasury at 5.32% (Aug 18) and PJM capacity prices up ~6x YoY — concrete evidence that AI-infra debt supply is now repricing the broader cost of capital, tightening conditions for every leveraged AI-adjacent borrower.
